texts.zh:
我们发现了一只巨型腹足动物的化石，它不符合任何先前遭遇的物种，并被困在一块围绕[From.GetName]旋转的巨大冰块中。它的眼睛怒视前方，触手扬起，鼻口扭曲成可怕的样子，好像被定格在一道无声的狂啸之中。该生物似乎没有明显的智慧特征。

尽管其面目狰狞，我们的科学家认为如果能将其驯化，该生物可以为我们所用。他们建议提取一些DNA以供克隆。
texts.en:
We have discovered the fossilized remains of a gargantuan gastropod, matching no previously encountered lifeform, trapped within a huge block of ice circling [From.GetName]. Its eyes glare fiercely ahead, tentacles reared and muzzle twisted into a gruesome grimace, as if locked in a silent shout. The creature displays no apparent signs of sapience.

Despite its eerie visage, our scientists believe that if domesticated the creature could make a valuable asset. They recommend extracting some of its DNA for cloning.

texts.zh:
我们发现了一只巨型腹足动物的化石，它不符合任何先前遭遇的物种，并被困在一块围绕[From.GetName]旋转的巨大冰块中。它的眼睛怒视前方，触手扬起，鼻口扭曲成可怕的样子，好像被定格在一道无声的狂啸之中。该生物似乎没有明显的智慧特征。

可惜以我们目前的科技实力，无法将其复生。
texts.en:
We have discovered the fossilized remains of a gargantuan gastropod, matching no previously encountered lifeform, trapped within a huge block of ice circling [From.GetName]. Its eyes glare fiercely ahead, tentacles reared and muzzle twisted into a gruesome grimace, as if locked in a silent shout. The creature displays no apparent signs of sapience.

Unfortunately we currently lack the technology to bring it back to life.

label.zh: 提取基因样本并加以储存，以备未来使用。
label.en: Extract and store a DNA sample for future use.

label.zh: 这块冻肉看起来可真新鲜啊！
label.en: A well refrigerated meal. How refreshing!

note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
某种未知生命体被困在冰层之中，没人知道这生命体是从何处而来、到底经历了多么漫长的岁月。

我们的研究员已做好充分准备，打算复活这个生命体。
texts.en:
Trapped within in a mountainous slab of ice are the remains of a lifeform, the likes of which have never seen before. Who knows how far it has traveled through space and time.

Our researchers have made the necessary preparations to bring it back to life.

texts.zh: 我们利用化石的DNA成功地克隆出了一批巨型蛞蝓。它们于数周后发育成熟，重达20吨，并发展出了原始的智慧，会对简单的指令做出反应。尽管尚未表露出任何凶猛的本性，它们在被激怒时会分泌一种粘稠的毒液，而且它们的颜色也会随情绪而改变。因为它们相互沟通之时会发出兹兹声，科研团队将其命名为“阿兹詹虫”。
texts.en: We have successfully cloned a healthy population of gargantuan slugs from the fossilized DNA. They reached maturity within weeks, weighing up to 20 tons, and have developed a primitive level of sapience, responding to simple one-syllable commands. Though they have yet to show any violent tendencies, they produce a thick, toxic mucus when vexed, and their hue seems to shift with their mood. The research team has named them 'Azizians' for the hissing sounds with which they communicate among themselves.

label.zh: 它们会成为优秀的奴隶。
每月20%几率：劳工变得完全智慧
label.en: Monthly 20% chance: the laborers become sapient

label.zh: 它们应该待在动物园里。
每月20%几率：动物园里的阿兹詹虫暴走
label.en: Monthly 20% chance: the zoo Azizians break out

label.zh: 我们可以把它们收编进军团。
label.en: We could use them in the army.

tooltips.zh: 谁不想要一大群凶猛的蛞蝓来碾压其敌人呢？
tooltips.en: Who would not want an army of murderous slugs with which to crush their enemies?

label.zh: 简直令人毛骨悚然。立即把它们处理掉！
label.en: They are horrendous. Dispose of them NOW!
We have seen enough. Butcher them now.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的阿兹詹虫劳工发展出了完整的智慧。我们本以为它们已经发育成熟时，其实仍在幼年期，而现在进入成年期的它们才完全展露了潜力。它们学会了我们的语言，并希望留在我们的文明里。
texts.en: The Azizian laborers on [Root.GetName] have developed full sapience. The creatures, who were believed to have already reached full maturity, were in fact still spawn and are only now, in adulthood, reaching their full potential. They have picked up our language and wish to remain here in our civilization.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 饲养在[Root.GetName]上动物园里的阿兹詹虫腹足动物逃了出来，并开始四处破坏！我们本以为它们已经发育成熟，可它们却在笼子里继续成长，体积犹如怪物一般巨大。它们横穿城市，像积木一样推倒建筑，在所经之处留下一道亮黄色的毒液。星球再也不会像过去那样了。
texts.en: The Azizian gastropods kept in the Zoo on [Root.GetName] have broken out and gone on a rampage! The creatures, who were believed to have reached full maturity, continued to grow in captivity and have since reached monstrous proportions. They tore through the city, knocking over buildings like game pieces, leaving in their wake a trail of bright yellow toxic mucus. The planet will never be the same again.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们最近在克隆领域取得了巨大的技术突破，科学家们将取自冰层中的某个疑似灭绝的外星生物的基因再次拿了出来。现在我们终于可以让这神秘的有机生命体重新复活了。
texts.en: Following our recent breakthrough within the field of cloning, our scientists have brought the alien DNA extracted from a presumably extinct alien, found within an ice slab, out from storage. Restoring the mysterious organism to life has been a long-lasting dream for the department, now made possible through the miracle of science.

label.zh: 允许他们复活神秘的有机生命体。

label.en: They will do no such thing.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的垃圾场边缘，漂浮着一艘来源不明的破旧科研船。船壳上的咬痕与消化液表明它曾被某种大型食肉动物咀嚼，然后反刍。

讽刺的是，舰船的船员也在进行自己的美食之旅，寻找新的异星美味，结果自己却成了盘中餐。

他们对大量的物种进行了评估，从营养成分到咀嚼口感等各个方面。他们评价最高的物种之一是[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，因其[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName]多汁，而且性情暴躁。而我们则在排名底端得了中庸的评价，因为我们的肉嚼起来费劲，而且反抗无力。有些人还真喜欢与食物玩耍……
texts.en:
Floating on the outskirts of the debris field around [From.GetName] is the pitiful form of a crumpled-up science vessel of unidentifiable origin. The presence of bite-marks and digestive fluids on the hull suggest it was chewed up, then regurgitated by some large predator.

Ironically, the ship's crew were on a culinary odyssey of their own, in search of new exotic delicacies, when they themselves ended up on the menu.

They had rated a staggering number of lifeforms on everything from nutritional content to chewiness. Among their top picks were the [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for their juicy [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName] and spicy temperament. We have earned a mediocre placement at the bottom of the list thanks to the stringiness of our flesh and the lackluster quarry we make. Some like to play with their food...

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]周围的垃圾场边缘，漂浮着一艘来源不明的破旧科研船。船壳上的咬痕与消化液表明它曾被某种大型食肉动物咀嚼，然后吐了出来。

讽刺的是，舰船上的船员也在进行自己的美食之旅，寻找新的异星美味，结果自己却成了盘中餐。

他们已经从营养成分到咀嚼口感等各个方面对海量物种进行了评估。他们首选的是[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，因为[delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName]鲜美多汁且性情暴躁。我们在这份列表中排名很低，被归入了一种以星号圈起的特殊类别，因为我们根本不可食用并且毫无猎取的乐趣。有些人还真喜欢与食材玩耍……
texts.en:
Floating on the outskirts of the debris field around [From.GetName] is the pitiful form of a crumpled-up science vessel of unidentifiable origin. The presence of bite-marks and digestive fluids on the hull suggest it was chewed up, then regurgitated by some large predator.

Ironically, the ship's crew were on a culinary odyssey of their own, in search of new exotic delicacies, when they themselves ended up on the menu.

They had rated a staggering number of lifeforms on everything from nutritional content to chewiness. Among their top picks were the [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesNamePlural], for their juicy [delicious_aliens.GetSpeciesOrganName] and spicy temperament. We have earned a special category at the bottom of the list surrounded by asterisks, thanks to the utter inedibility of our flesh and the lackluster quarry we make. Some like to play with their food...

label.zh: 看来他们终于碰到对手了……
label.en: Looks like they finally met their match...

tooltips.en: Communications enabled with the [delicious_aliens.GetName], the galaxy's most delicious aliens.

label.zh: 不排复杂度排什么口感？真奇怪。
label.en: Rating by taste rather than complexity? How odd.

texts.zh: 我们在垃圾中找到了一颗原本可以居住的星球的碎片。破碎的方式与碎片上的焦痕表明，它受到了集束热能的冲击，直到它在压力下裂开为止。这使其矿物丰富的核心可以外泄，并固化成高品质矿物块。
texts.en: Among the debris we have discovered the shattered remains of a formerly habitable planet. The patterns of fragmentation and charring on the shards suggest it was blasted with concentrated beams of thermal energy until it cracked from the pressure. This allowed for the mineral-rich core to spill out and solidify into clumps of high-quality minerals.

summary.text:
# 残骸场 / Debris Field

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:1115-1177; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:2851 (distar.1080); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:1177 (ICE_ALIEN); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:2937 (distar.1081); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:101; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:3050-3131 (distar.1082); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:3134/3163 (distar.1083/1084); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2697; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:3208 (distar.1085); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:2176 (distar.1050); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:3326 (distar.2000)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。小行星可能生成（3级，权重3，每个帝国一次）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on asteroids (level 3, weight 3, once per empire).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

结果三选一（各基础权重1）：
- distar.1080“无声狂啸”（已有克隆科技时权重×3；格式塔或 mol8 头像为0）：冰块中封着一只巨型腹足类化石。有克隆科技可立即克隆 → ICE_ALIEN（1000社会学）→ distar.1081“阿兹詹虫”；没有则可储存DNA，日后研究出克隆时 distar.1085 再问是否复活。也可扔掉或送进博物馆。distar.1081：做劳工（4个前智慧人口组）→ 之后每月20%几率 distar.1084“阿兹詹虫的智慧”（它们变为完全智慧）；进动物园（宠物矿藏）→ 每月20%几率 distar.1083 逃出暴走（星球受损并出现危险野生动物）；编入军队；或处理掉。
- distar.1050“吃或被吃”（机械/合成帝国为0）：一艘美食探险船被吃掉，它的“美味排行榜”让我们与“最美味的外星人”建立联系。
- distar.2000“粉碎星球”（星球已有站点矿藏时为0）：被热能束击碎的星球留下高品质矿物（矿物矿藏）。

One of three results (base weight 1 each):
- distar.1080 "Silent Shout" (×3 with Cloning; 0 for gestalts or portrait mol8): a gigantic gastropod fossil frozen in ice. With Cloning it can be cloned at once → ICE_ALIEN (1000 society) → distar.1081 "Azizians"; without it the DNA can be stored, and distar.1085 asks again once Cloning is researched. It can also be spaced or sent to a museum. distar.1081: laborers (4 pre-sapient pop groups) → monthly 20% chance of distar.1084 "Azizian Wisdom" (they become fully sapient); zoo (pet deposits) → monthly 20% chance of distar.1083, a rampage (devastation and dangerous wildlife); army; or disposal.
- distar.1050 "Eat or be Eaten" (0 for machine/synthetic empires): a gourmet expedition ship was eaten; its taste rankings put us in contact with "the galaxy's most delicious aliens".
- distar.2000 "Shattered World" (0 if the body has station deposits): a planet shattered by thermal beams left rich minerals (minerals deposit).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

三个异常结果互斥；distar.1081 四个处置互斥，只有劳工与动物园有后续（1084 / 1083）。

The three anomaly results are exclusive; distar.1081's four choices are exclusive and only laborers/zoo have follow-ups (1084 / 1083).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

克隆科技决定 distar.1080 的正文和可用选项；演化猎手在 1080、1081、1050 有专属选项；distar.1050 对石质物种的排名措辞不同。

Cloning decides distar.1080's text and options; Evolutionary Predators have extra options in 1080, 1081 and 1050; distar.1050 words the ranking differently for lithoids.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常权重与修正、distar.1050、1080–1085、2000、ICE_ALIEN 及 on_tech_increased / on_monthly_pulse。修正：草稿把“冰层中的外星生命体”（event-distar-1085）与“阿兹詹虫逃跑了”（event-distar-1082）分成独立故事；现以审阅连接并入（储存DNA→研究克隆后；劳工/动物园→每月检查）。30天后的通用接触报告 story.5 是共享事件，不属于本故事。

Checked the weights and modifiers, distar.1050, 1080–1085, 2000, ICE_ALIEN and on_tech_increased / on_monthly_pulse. Correction: "Ice Alien" (event-distar-1085) and "Azizians on the loose!" (event-distar-1082) were separate stories; they are now joined by reviewed links (stored DNA → after Cloning; laborers/zoo → monthly check). The generic contact report story.5 30 days later is a shared helper, not part of this story.
